subject: Quantify renewal: phased evidence rotation, retention slice, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@quantify.co>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@quantify.co
Date: Fri, 5 Oct 2028 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal questions (Quantify)

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the renewal proposal. We’re preparing for our annual SOC2 re-attestation and there are three items from our side we need to lock down before legal will sign the amendment:

1) Evidence handoff cadence — can Redwood support a phased evidence rotation rather than a single bulk transfer? We want to preserve a slice of audit logs in-region for 18 months and push older slices to archive.
2) Retention carveouts — our compliance team needs a clear mapping of log retention windows by region and by workload (prod vs analytics).
3) Capacity/top-up pricing — with projected usage growth Q4–Q1 we may need burst capacity and a temporary seat top-up for two months during the audit window.

Can you and your security contact outline an operational playbook (timeline, named owners, and attachment format) and confirm whether an overlay addendum to the existing contract will work for the short-term seat/top-up?

Also copying our procurement team for scheduling.

Appreciate it —
Julia Park
Head of Compliance, Quantify Analytics
Julia.Park@quantify.co

---
Attachment: Quantify_SOC2_GapList_2028-09.pdf (application/pdf)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@quantify.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Oct 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal questions (Quantify)

Julia —

Thanks for the clear ask and the gap list — that helps. We can absolutely support a phased evidence rotation and short-term capacity top-up. High level plan below; I'll follow with an operations runbook and a draft term addendum for legal next week.

Operational summary (high level)
- Evidence rotation: we propose a 3-phase handoff (initial snapshot, rolling 30-day slices, final cutover). This reduces simultaneous I/O and preserves an 18-month nearline slice in the customer region.
- Retention mapping: we’ll provide a per-workload retention table (prod: 18 months hot, analytics: 12 months hot then 36 months archive) and an export manifest format (CSV + sha256 checksums).
- Capacity uplift: two-month burst seats (reserved + burst pool) — we can offer a temporary commit with automatic rollback to baseline. Pricing and entitlement options in the term addendum.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly — can you draft the operations runbook for the phased handoff and attach a sample CSV manifest?
2) Marcus — can you confirm the burst-seat pricing and whether we need a signed amendment vs PO?
3) Julia — is October 18–20 a hard freeze window for your auditors? If so we’ll align timelines.

I’ll assemble a single document that combines the runbook, mapping table, and the drafted amendment for your counsel.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Julia Park <julia.park@quantify.co>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Oct 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal questions (Quantify)

Julie / Sergio —

Drafted the operations runbook and attached a proposed CSV manifest layout (proposed-evidence-rotation.csv). Key callouts:

- Phase 1 (Initial snapshot, day 0–3): 
  * Source: prod-control-plane logs, application audit trails.
  * Delivery: secure SFTP + signed manifest.
  * Owner: Redwood Compliance Ops (kimberly_park@redwood.ai).

- Phase 2 (Rolling slices, day 4–30):
  * 30-day incremental slices pushed nightly to Quantify’s S3 (VPC endpoint).
  * Retain hot slice for 18 months in us-east-1 per your ask.

- Phase 3 (Final verification, day 31–45):
  * Final hash reconciliation and deliverable to Tidal Assurance for audit pickup.

Attachment notes: CSV includes fields (slice_start, slice_end, workload_tag, sha256, size_bytes, s3_uri, delivered_at). We can also provide a minimal JSON manifest per slice if your tooling prefers.

I’ll incorporate feedback from Marcus on the entitlement side and the legal addendum.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: proposed-evidence-rotation.csv (text/csv)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Julia Park <julia.park@quantify.co>
Date: Tue, 9 Oct 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal questions (Quantify)

Julia —

Pricing/entitlement options for the two-month audit uplift: 

Option A (Temporary seat top-up): +20 seats for 60 days, prepaid via PO. Seats auto-revert to baseline after 60 days. 10% discount on standard seat rate for temporary commits.
Option B (Burst pool): Pay-per-use burst at $X/token-equivalent with a soft cap; we invoice monthly and can cap to avoid surprise spend.

Contract mechanics: we can do a one-page overlay addendum (term amendment) that references your existing SOW and includes: uplift period, seat counts, retention carveouts, evidence-handling SLA, and audit contact points. Legal doesn’t require a full redline for a short-term overlay — a countersigned addendum or PO will suffice.

I’ll attach a first-pass term addendum and cost sheet by Thursday.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: redwood-term-amendment-draft-20281010.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Julia Park <julia.park@quantify.co>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@quantify.co, Tidal Assurance <audits@tidal-assurance.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal questions (Quantify)

Sergio / Kim / Marcus —

This plan looks good. A couple of clarifications before I route to legal and procurement: 
- Can you confirm that the 18-month hot slice will be stored in our us-east-1 account and that Redwood will provide cross-account ARN and temporary credentials for retrieval?
- For the manifest, Tidal prefers the CSV but would accept the JSON manifest as supplementary metadata.
- Please mark the term addendum as "temporary audit uplift" and include an explicit rollback clause for commitments after 60 days.

If you can get the addendum and the CSV manifest by Thursday 10/18, we’ll schedule a 30-minute call with our auditors 10/19 to walk through the handoff. Procurement is standing by to issue a PO once the addendum is countersigned.

Thanks —
Julia
Head of Compliance, Quantify Analytics
